home.name: The Eye
home.heroBody: Your central navigation array for charting, organizing, and stabilizing your settled systems.
home.cardDesc: Central hub for all your modding tools and collection management.

rebuild.name: Grav Drive Jump
rebuild.heroBody: Bypass local bottlenecks—re-extract heavy collections at lightspeed, completely free of Vortex constraints.
rebuild.cardDesc: Re-extract collections at full speed, free of Vortex constraints.

update-collection-v2.name: Memory Fragment
update-collection-v2.heroBody: Never lose your custom configurations to an update again—automated snapshots preserve your choices through every iteration.
update-collection-v2.cardDesc: Preserve your custom setup across every update automatically.

sync.name: Memory Fragment
sync.heroBody: Never lose your custom configurations to an update again—automated snapshots preserve your choices through every iteration.
sync.cardDesc: Preserve your custom setup across every update automatically.

rules-generator.name: Quantum Entanglement
rules-generator.heroBody: Instantly bridge legacy conflict rules to updated mod versions without spending hours matching them by hand.
rules-generator.cardDesc: Auto-map your existing conflict rules onto updated mods instantly.

merge.name: Staryard Assembly Line
merge.heroBody: Consolidate scattered plugins into single bundles and auto-qualify them as ESL equivalents to save precious load order slots.
merge.cardDesc: Bundle plugins into one file and auto-ESL to reclaim load order slots.

missing-masters.name: Structural Hull Breach
missing-masters.heroBody: Detect missing master files the instant they occur and patch them with a single click to prevent desktop crashes.
missing-masters.cardDesc: Catch missing masters instantly—no more crash to desktop.

scrub.name: Deimos Salvage Yard
scrub.heroBody: Sweep away orphaned staging folders, dead downloads, and leftover debris with customizable permanent exclusion lists.
scrub.cardDesc: Clean up orphaned folders and dead downloads safely.

archive-finder.name: Akila City Archive
archive-finder.heroBody: Index your entire downloads library upfront and search across every compressed archive instantly—zero unpacking required.
archive-finder.cardDesc: Search all archives instantly without unpacking a single byte.

missing-files.name: Cydonia Ore Extraction
missing-files.heroBody: Target and restore only the files that quietly went missing from your staging folders, straight from the source archive.
missing-files.cardDesc: Restore only the missing files—no need for a full rebuild.

file-retriever.name: Trade Authority Requisition
file-retriever.heroBody: Nexus not letting you download a file? Is that Archive not available? It is now. Enter any mod ID to pull up its complete cargo manifest, check off the specific revisions or legacy packages you need, and beam them straight into your local hold without the web kiosk red tape.
file-retriever.cardDesc: Enter a mod's ID to inspect its full cargo manifest and beam specific or archived files straight to your local drive.

cycle-helper.name: Serpent's Embrace
cycle-helper.heroBody: Untangle load-order priority loops instantly by isolating the single bad rule responsible and flipping it on the spot.
cycle-helper.cardDesc: Find and fix the one bad rule causing your cycle instantly.

remove-collection.name: Neon Red-Tape Audit
remove-collection.heroBody: Purge old collections safely with a pre-removal audit that flags and protects shared mods still used by your other setups.
remove-collection.cardDesc: Audit shared dependencies before removal—nothing shared goes missing.

report-stats.name: Starborn Telemetry
report-stats.heroBody: Track historical run efficiency and surface mods needing attention without digging through raw log files.
report-stats.cardDesc: Historical rebuild trends and mods needing attention at a glance.

report-workthrough.name: Constellation Mission Board
report-workthrough.heroBody: Conquer all your modding issues across every collection from a single, persistent, interactive checklist.
report-workthrough.cardDesc: Every problem mod across all collections in one persistent checklist.

report-updatecompare.name: Star System Cartography
report-updatecompare.heroBody: Inspect a crystal-clear before-and-after manifest of every addition, removal, and change following an update.
report-updatecompare.cardDesc: Inspect before-and-after of what was added, removed, or changed in an update.

report-rulesgen.name: Quantum Link Status
report-rulesgen.heroBody: Review at a glance which conflict rules successfully self-mapped and which still require your manual sign-off.
report-rulesgen.cardDesc: See which rules linked cleanly and which need your review.

report-workshop.name: Relic Chronology
report-workshop.heroBody: Unmask static web dates with true revision history timestamps to see which collections you've actually touched recently.
report-workshop.cardDesc: The real last-touched date for each Workshop collection from revision history.

report-exceptions.name: Constellation Quarantine Zone
report-exceptions.heroBody: Shield hand-picked, custom-installer mods from automated batch rebuilds to protect your precise micro-choices.
report-exceptions.cardDesc: Protect hand-picked mods from automated rebuilds.

settings.name: Ship Customization Terminal
settings.heroBody: Configure your core Vortex paths, staging directories, and global preferences once for the entire application fleet.
settings.cardDesc: Set paths and preferences once for all tools.

clear-update-flags.name: False Beacon Jammer
clear-update-flags.heroBody: Scrub false update flags and silence unwanted upgrade pings across curated collections, with full roll-back protection.
clear-update-flags.cardDesc: Silence false update flags with full rollback protection.

pgpatcher.name: Modular Shipbuilder Matrix
pgpatcher.heroBody: Set visual priority for conflicting meshes and textures, re-ordering overrides before triggering an automatic PGPatcher rebuild.
pgpatcher.cardDesc: Dictate visual priority for conflicting meshes and textures.

report-mergeupdatereport.name: Drydock Variance Report
report-mergeupdatereport.heroBody: Securing upgraded grav-drive manifolds in your cargo bay does nothing for the welded hab module already sealed and pressurized on the pad—a structural merge remains locked to the exact revision specs clamped into the jig on assembly day. The Drydock Variance Report checks your current mod manifests against every composite plugin built on the line. It flags updated supplier parts and maps them directly to the merged modules carrying stale blueprints, giving you an exact refit punch list before launch.
report-mergeupdatereport.cardDesc: Maps blueprint drift across welded ship modules—giving you an exact refit punch list for stale staryard merges.

report-mergehistory.name: Flight Data Recorder
report-mergehistory.heroBody: Audit built merges against your active load order to catch zombie plugins or missing merged archives, restoring balance in one click.
report-mergehistory.cardDesc: Audit merges against active load order to catch drift and missing archives.

duplicate-version-cleanup.name: Staryard Blueprint Arbitration
duplicate-version-cleanup.heroBody: Updating mods across multiple collections often strands legacy version entries inside your ship manifest dropdowns. Staryard Blueprint Arbitration isolates orphaned revisions from intentionally pinned variants, downloading and reinstalling a pristine survivor so your mod loadout matches your actual flight plan.
duplicate-version-cleanup.cardDesc: Consolidates duplicate version records into a single clean reinstallation without breaking collection-specific variants.

save-cleaner.name: Unity Sieve
save-cleaner.heroBody: Every jump across the settled systems leaves stray quantum echoes in your save file from mods left behind in older universes. The Unity Sieve analyzes your character's record, groups orphaned script instances by their origin mod, and sifts out the dead weight so your journey continues unburdened.
save-cleaner.cardDesc: Sifts orphaned script fragments and timeline debris directly out of your character's save file.
